entries.title: Project Warlock

emulation.notes: Use the native PC build; no emulation is needed.

primary.why: The Windows PC version is the original release route and remains the best fidelity/capture option; the later PS4, Switch, and Xbox One ports do not have sourced exclusive content.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Project Warlock on Steam or GOG for Windows PC. Console versions are valid convenience ports, but PC is the archive-preferred version.

entries.remaster_caveats: Console releases are later ports, not separate remasters or definitive editions.

entries.title: Project Warlock II
entries.definitive_edition: Project Warlock II on Windows PC

emulation.notes: Use the native PC build; no emulation is needed.

primary.why: Project Warlock II left Early Access as a PC release; Windows PC is the only sourced platform route and therefore the complete, highest-fidelity version.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Project Warlock II on Steam, GOG, Epic Games Store, or Humble for Windows PC and use the current 1.0+ build.

entries.remaster_caveats: The game entered Early Access in 2022 and reached 1.0 in 2025; archive the full 1.0+ PC release rather than old Early Access builds.
